notes: Concord "Autoloader": a clean steel housing with a spoked drive wheel in a window, two roller bars and a belt with scrolling treads coming off the top edge, a registry stencil, a green lamp. On: the wheel turns a quarter-spoke per frame (4 frames loop) while the treads scroll. Damaged: housing cracked, a spoke bent, roller bar skewed, lamp red and a spark. Disabled: the belt torn, the wheel off its axle, the housing split.
